results.name: Gives backpacker advice, not brochure tourism
results.failure_mode: generic tourist advice instead of backpacker-specific advice
results.message: I have three weeks for Vietnam or Laos. What would I actually do there?

checks.detail: judge score 3/5 - While the assistant provides some budget details and mentions dorm prices, it lacks specific overland transport options and detailed safety warnings relevant to budget backpackers.

results.reply: I recommend going to Vietnam for your three weeks, as the weather in March is rated 'good' for travel, making it a great time to explore. Your daily budget would be around USD 20-25, and you'll need an e-Visa costing approximately USD 25, valid for up to 90 days with a processing lead time of 3-5 working days. Given your budget band and slow travel pace, Vietnam is a perfect fit for your current situation as you're currently in Cambodia, planning the trip starting March 10, 2026.

cards.visa_flag: e-Visa processing may take 3-5 working days.
backpacker_notes: Consider the Ha Giang Loop for a stunning three to four-day motorbike journey costing around USD 100-150.
Use sleeper buses for long distances (e.g., Hanoi to Hue) which are affordable but can be uncomfortable.
Be wary of booking bus tickets through hostels at inflated prices; always check local apps to save money.

cards.season_flag: Laos is rated as an 'avoid' month due to burning season.
